summary: In this excerpt from Book 10, the narrator Jap describes his new assignment in a top-floor office of Operations 1 under his boss Rhindquist, who asks him odd questions and gives him a raise after Jap recounts his Basic Training, the File-O-Gator Vision Statement, and the Anthill Simulator lesson. Jap also describes afternoon movie sessions with Rhindquist, including Educating Rita, and notes that his roommate Tony works in the basement of Operations 1 and looked worried.
one_line: Jap, a File-O-Gator employee, describes his office work under Rhindquist, a raise, afternoon movies, and seeing his roommate Tony.
key_facts: The narrator Jap works in a beautiful office on the top floor of Operations 1, one hundred floors above ground.
Rhindquist sits in the chair by the door, talks on his phone, and asks Jap odd questions such as whether the pinheads in HR know their ass from a hole in the ground.
Jap tells Rhindquist about Basic Training, the history of File-O-Gator, and the Vision Statement that he memorized.
The File-O-Gator Vision Statement describes the organization as a diverse multinational sovereign power that is a World-Class Leader in its fields of Operations.
Jap says the HR Sergeant was always fair about Training Appraisals and disciplined people who goofed in the showers.
Jap played the Anthill Simulator and learned that the one drone does not know why he is moving a grain of sand, but from the Queen's seat in the middle it all makes sense.

Jap says he follows the lesson of the Anthill Simulator when his watch asks him to do something he does not understand or when strange things happen, such as his roommate Tony covering up all the plugs.
Rhindquist calls Jap his bright boy and a walking focus-group, and says he is not paying Jap enough.
Rhindquist calls someone on his phone and says Give my boy a raise, and Jap receives a raise.
Jap sends home a little money as an attachment with his note, along with a picture of himself in his Special Vice-President's suit.
Every afternoon Rhindquist shuts off his phone and Jap's watch, and a pretty secretary wheels in a big TV for movies.
Yesterday the pair watched Educating Rita, and Rhindquist told Jap that he is like Rita.
Jap describes Rita as a dumb girl from England, Ltd., who works as a hairdresser until someone from management teaches her about life.
Jap's crazy old roommate Tony works in Operations 1 in the basement.
Jap saw Tony getting off the slidewalk and heading to the basement elevators that morning, and Tony looked worried.
